The '''Giant Decay Mite Cave''' was a cave west of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was populated by giant [[decay mite]]s. [[Scientist/Legends|Scientists]] believed that something in the rock of the cave had triggered these impressive changes within the insects.<ref name="SWG:GDMC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Giant Decay Mite Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GDMC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> This location was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]," released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
